notes: A127750_mod_two: A127750 n % 2 = A036987 n for all n, with A127749 = T proved to be the (unique) inverse of [k<=n<=2k]/(2n+1) (T_inverse, T_unique). Window sums of the inverse of M=[k<=n<=2k] give t(n,k) = [n=k]-[n-1=k]+[n odd]t((n-1)/2,k); row sums R(n)=[n odd]R((n-1)/2) = A036987; A127750 = R + 2(...). Outside Lean: none.
